summary.text: Mike Rush is a Democratic member of the Massachusetts Senate for the Norfolk and Suffolk District, which includes five Boston neighborhoods and Dedham, Norwood, Walpole and Westwood, and was elected to the Senate in 2010 after serving in the House from 2003 to 2010.
His official biography says he serves as Senate Majority Whip and Chair of the Senate Committee on Personnel and Administration.

paragraphs.text: Michael F. Rush's official biography says he was a high school history teacher before his election to the Legislature and is an adjunct instructor of history.
It lists a J.D. from Southern New England School of Law and an M.A. and B.A. from Providence College.

The biography says he is an Iraq War veteran and a Commander in the United States Navy Reserve, and that he earlier served as an enlisted sailor with Naval Mobile Construction Battalion 27, the Seabees.
In the House he represented the 10th Suffolk District and served as Historian of the House.
He lives in West Roxbury with his wife Mary and their three children.
The Legislature's committee listing shows him as Chair of the Senate Committee on Personnel and Administration and Vice Chair of the Joint Committee on Veterans and Federal Affairs.
